body:
Tap and Blend: 1. sit 2. bus 3. three sounds, /h/ /e/ /n/ 4. short o, /o/.
Word Builders: 1. hat 2. big 3. hot.
Short Vowel Check: 1. u 2. e 3. a 4. i 5. pot, read with a short o.
Scoring tip: a student who says the right vowel aloud but writes another letter is Getting there on "I wrote the right vowel".
title: Answer key: Short Vowel Sounds
